Invite

Supplier facilities that have joined the supply chain program counted by submission status.


• Suppliers that have completed their data and

  action are ready to be reviewed.

• Suppliers whose submissions are in progress /

  not started / have no actions will be contacted to

  complete their submissions

De-selected to only include data from suppliers who have ‘Completed’ their data submission.


If selected, data from incomplete submissions will also be included. This means:


• If a supplier provided partical CO2 data, the

  partial data wil be displayed.

• If a supplier have not yet provided any data, an

  estimate would be made based on their most

  recent data submission in previous years.

Currently allocated CO2e for 2022 is at 76% of 2021 level, and participants count at 85%.
